title: The Ridge Where Ore Remembers Its Becoming

features.name: ore memory
features.desc-on-touch: The copper remembers its time as stone before any tool touched it. Here it speaks that deep memory, slower than geology.

features.name: extraction scar
features.desc-on-touch: The ridge holds the shape of taking. The ore remembers the moment it learned it could become more than itself.

features.name: transformation layer
features.desc-on-touch: Each stratum holds a stage of becoming. Ore to metal to form to rust to earth—the copper traces its own return.

features.name: copper's teaching
features.desc-on-touch: The ridge learned how to hold the story of transformation. The ore teaches: becoming is not loss, only change.

inscription: ore remembers its time as pure stone; now it teaches the ridge that transformation is not forgetting, only speaking in a different depth

reverie.title: REVERIE — sitting on the ridge where the mining stopped
narr: You and Leif sat on the old ridge, where the extraction ended.
He picked up a stone, turned it over. 'It knows what it was,
before we wanted it to be something else.' He placed it back.
The earth had healed itself around the absence. The ridge taught
you both: transformation is not forgetting. The copper remembers stone.
